CHAIRPERSON’S
STATEMENT
Dr. MG Waweru, Chairman

It is with great pleasure that I welcome you all to our 58th Annual General Meeting.
At East African Cables Plc, we uphold our core values, one of which is, Care in all our interactions. This
applies to safety in our workplaces, safety of all our products and in our supply chains. We believe that
when we care for our people, business partners, stakeholders and environment, we make the world a
better place for all of us.
I also take this opportunity to inform you that our refreshed strategy, has started bearing fruits in form of
market and customer needs alignment, efficiency improvement and this is evident in the growth recorded
in this year’s results. We continue to focus on becoming a better organisation to deliver more value to our
stakeholders and the world at large.
